fact: A four-year African Development Bank grant to WATAF, launched 18 August 2026, covers Guinea-Bissau among six countries and is said to support digital tax tools and VAT and e-invoicing reforms.
system: Strengthening Tax Administration Capacity Project in West Africa (STACP-WA)

fact: The Guinea-Bissau tax directorate (DGCI) circular of 10 December 2025 makes declaration and payment of import-related VAT compulsory exclusively through the Kontaktu platform, and the portal's simplified payment area lets some taxes be paid without a declaration file.

ANG reports that by Despacho 01/GP/CMB/2026, signed on 1 June 2026 for 90 days, Bissau's municipal council requires payments of 1,000 FCFA or more for fees, licences, fines, taxes and other municipal services to be made only by deposit or transfer to its bank accounts.
